text:
emily: PSA: my vintage lava lamp single-handedly murdered my wifi this morning. thought it was my ISP for 20 min. pic: (image: lava-lamp-router.jpg) https://photos.app.goo.gl/example 
dan: wait is the lava lamp now a sanctioned network appliance? :joy:
carlos: lol did it start advertising an SSID called LAVA-EXT?
emily: not funny, it literally causes packet loss when the blobs move. router is on the same Ikea shelf. heat + glass? magic? :sweat_smile:
tina: brand/model? maybe PWM noise from the bulb? I had interference from old desk lamps once.
emily: it's one of those heavy 70s repro ones, no regulation stickers. unplugged it and wifi came back instantly.
infra-bot: automated check kicked by emily at 2150001240 — staging ping before unplug: avg 312ms, after unplug: avg 22ms. full log posted to #eng-infra.
rachel: wow. honorary mention for "most surprising home office saboteur" nomination. also vote: show-and-tell WFH setups tomorrow?
dan: yes pls. my living room keyboard cat deserves the limelight.
carlos: i'm in. morning or afternoon?
tina: poll: 10:00am or 4:00pm — react with :one: for 10am, :two: for 4pm.
emily: :two: (4pm works better so I can tidy/evict lava lamp)
dan: :one: (mornings for me)
carlos: :one:
rachel: :two:
infra-bot: poll tally at 2150001265 — :one: 2 votes, :two: 2 votes. tie persists.
tina: ok tie-breaker: whoever posts the messiest setup has to bring virtual pastries to the next all-hands. stakes!
emily: challenge accepted. also i'll post the lamp pic in the thread since img host is flaky: (image: lava-lamp-router-close.jpg)
dan: :laughing: :thumbsup:
carlos: can someone run a quick channel/DFS scan for shared interference sources? or is that too much? :nerd_face:
infra-bot: if anyone wants, I can run a 2.4/5GHz overlap map for the office region and a quick script for home networks. ping me with your zip code or general city.
emily: thanks infra-bot! may share later after I remove the suspect lamp from my topology.
rachel: adding a reminder: this is the kind of light, silly banter that keeps morale up. love it.
emily: ok team, lava lamp is now exiled to the back closet. feel free to roast it in tomorrow's show-and-tell.
